faqs.q: What are Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Copper tube with helical grooves rolled inside, which raise the refrigerant-side heat transfer, to EN 12735-2, ASTM B359 and GB/T 20928, for air-conditioning and refrigeration coils. It is listed in 11 sizes, 7–15.87 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes, such as IH-TF-EC-ENH-0095-030?
faqs.a: Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes part numbers begin with IH-TF-EC-ENH and then give the outside diameter in tenths of a millimetre and the wall thickness in hundredths of a millimetre. IH-TF-EC-ENH-0095-030 is 9.52 mm outside diameter by 0.30 mm wall, and IH-TF-EC-ENH-0159-058 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.

faqs.q: What sizes do Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes come in?
faqs.a: Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes are listed in 11 sizes, 7–15.87 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-EC-ENH-0095-030 and IH-TF-EC-ENH-0159-058. The table includes 9.52 mm OD by 0.30 mm wall and 15.87 mm OD by 0.58 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes?
faqs.a: For Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes, mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes are available in these grades: Cu-DHP C12200; CuNi10Fe1Mn C70600. The fin or coating material is internal helical grooves.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes?
faqs.a: Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes are made to GB/T 20928-2020, EN 12735-2, ASTM B359, ASTM B111. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes, tubes are rolled or welded into tube sheets or headers and carried on baffles or supports, so the outside diameter and wall must match the tube sheet drilling. Related ranges are the [Copper Tubes](/c/copper-tubes) and [Brass Tubes](/c/brass-condenser-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: How do Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes differ from Low-Fin Copper-Alloy Tubes?
faqs.a: Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes differ from [Low-Fin Copper-Alloy Tubes](/p/low-fin-copper-alloy-tubes) in its standards GB/T 20928-2020, EN 12735-2, ASTM B359, ASTM B111 against ASTM B359/B359M, EN 12452. It also differs in its base tube material Cu-DHP C12200; CuNi10Fe1Mn C70600 against C12200; C70600; C71500; C44300; fin material internal helical grooves against integral, rolled from the tube wall.

faqs.a: Yes. We ship Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.a: Yes, Inner-Grooved Copper Tubes are held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the sizes and quantities you need through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are Low-Fin Copper-Alloy Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Integral low-fin tubes in copper, admiralty brass and 90/10 and 70/30 copper-nickel to ASTM B359, with fin tips no larger than the plain end, for chillers, condensers and refrigerant evaporators. It is listed in 10 sizes, 15.875–25.4 mm outside diameter.

IH-TF-EC-LOF-0159-183-F159 is 15.875 mm outside diameter by 1.829 mm wall, and IH-TF-EC-LOF-0190-183-H012 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.
